units.title: Growth, decay and finance
units.why: Financial mathematics supports responsible decisions about savings, loans and inflation.
examples: R2 000 at 5% simple interest for 2 years earns R200
R1 000 at 10% compounded annually becomes R1 210 after 2 years
misconceptions: forgetting rate and term units must match
practice: Simple interest on R2 000 at 6% for 3 years.
Compound amount R1 000 at 10% for 2 years.
A price rises R80 to R100: percentage increase?
Why convert monthly rate for annual term?
Explain inflation's effect on buying power.

videoPackage.title: Making sense of growth
videoPackage.transcript: We keep the original amount as the percentage baseline, align rate and time units, and compare simple with compound growth.
